candidates.change_summary: Changed the return condition to always return true.
Changed the return condition to always return false.
Changed the interface ID check from IAccessControl to IERC165.
Replaced the logical OR with a logical AND.
Replace the return statement to always return true, ignoring the role and account.
Replace the return statement to always return false, ignoring the role and account.
Negate the return value, so it returns the opposite of the original.
Replace return value with a constant (0) instead of the actual admin role.
Remove the require statement in renounceRole, allowing any address to renounce any role assigned to it.
Replace the require condition with `require(true)`, effectively removing the self-renunciation restriction.
Change the require statement to check that the caller is not the account, reverting if the caller tries to renounce their own role.
Replace `isOperationPending(id)` with `!isOperation(id)` so that operations with timestamp > 0 but not pending can be cancelled.
Delete the require statement that checks if the operation is pending, allowing cancellation of any operation including those not yet scheduled.
Insert a `_timestamps[id] = 0;` statement after the require check, overriding the delete.
Change the modifier to always call `_checkRole` regardless of role existence, making the modifier require the role for all callers.
